lines: Every trench had one. Today the dogs came up the line.
Spot, Gyp, Bobby and the rest now sit beside their soldiers, on both sides of the wire.
Behind the Hegemony line, the Grey Mill gun opened fire for the first time.
Three Concord men were hit. All three died where they stood.
A hundred and twenty-six fell today. Forty-five Hegemony, eighty-one Concord.
The Concord is the bigger army, but its medics reached only seven in ten, and the Hegemony guns never stopped.
Bastian Wizzerd was named Propagandist of the Concord.
And Benedikt Lfer joined the Officers' Mess. The front thanks him.
The race for the Bone Quarry has begun. Concord thirty-one, Hegemony twenty-six.
First to three hundred digs a mine under the enemy line.
Yesterday three hundred and thirty-six new soldiers came up the line.
Two thousand and thirty-four now hold the front.
One thousand one hundred and one Concord.
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD to join. Trench Dogs come with Field Post on Patreon.
